title: Esrbespoke showcase
description: A full-window photo slideshow (4:5 on phones) with a small square tile in the middle showing the next picture under a black NEXT tag. The tile wipes open from the bottom as the section scrolls into view; pressing it crossfades the big picture to the next one.
notes: on the dark scope; empty slides are dark muted placeholders, the tile a lighter one
the tile's wipe is CSS scroll-driven inside @supports; the crossfade needs JavaScript (hydrate: visible)
off under reduced motion (the slides still change, without the fade)
